title: Allow Subset
statement: Implement `solve(allowed, requested)`. Both are lists of permission strings. Return 1 when every requested permission is in the allowed set, including when `requested` is empty. Return 0 when any request is missing.
hints: Build a set of allowed permissions.
Every requested item must be in that set.
all() of an empty request list is the success case. Return 1.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Permission checks are a subset test.

editorial: Permission checks are a subset test. A list scan per permission is quadratic in a long policy. A set of the allowed names answers each check in expected constant time. An empty request asks for nothing and succeeds.
